events.title: 와카야마의 시골 마을에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born in a village in Wakayama
events.description: 오사카 남쪽 와카야마의 작은 마을에서 팔 남매 중 막내로 태어났다. 아홉 살 때 초등학교를 마치지 못한 채 오사카로 보내져 견습공 생활을 시작했다.
events.description_en: He was born the youngest of eight children in a small village in Wakayama, south of Osaka. At nine, before finishing elementary school, he was sent to Osaka to begin an apprenticeship.

events.title: 오사카 전등에 배선공으로 들어가다
events.title_en: He joined Osaka Electric Light Company as a wiring apprentice
events.description: 자전거 가게 점원 생활을 마치고 오사카 전등 주식회사에 배선 견습공으로 들어갔다. 전기 산업과의 인연이 여기서 시작됐다.
events.description_en: After years as a bicycle shop clerk, he joined the Osaka Electric Light Company as a wiring apprentice. This was the start of his life in the electrical industry.

events.title: 아내와 처남과 전기기구 제작소를 세우다
events.title_en: He founded an electrical appliance works with his wife and brother-in-law
events.description: 오사카 전등을 그만두고 개량 소켓을 들고 아내 무메노, 처남 이우에 도시오와 함께 마쓰시타 전기기구 제작소를 세웠다. 처음엔 판매가 부진했다.
events.description_en: He left Osaka Electric Light Company and, with an improved light socket in hand, founded Matsushita Electric Housewares Manufacturing Works together with his wife Mumeno and her brother Toshio Iue. Sales were slow at first.

events.title: 경영 이념과 수도철학을 선포하다
events.title_en: He proclaimed his management creed and water philosophy
events.description: 회사의 사명과 일곱 가지 정신을 선포하며, 물처럼 값싸고 풍부하게 물건을 공급하는 것이 기업의 사회적 책무라는 수도철학을 밝혔다.
events.description_en: He proclaimed the company's mission and seven core principles, setting out his water philosophy: that a company's duty to society is to supply goods as cheaply and abundantly as tap water.

events.title: PHP연구소를 세우다
events.description: 평화와 행복과 번영을 뜻하는 PHP연구소를 세워 경영을 넘어선 사회사상 운동을 시작했다.
events.description_en: He founded the PHP Institute, named for Peace, Happiness, and Prosperity, launching a movement of social thought that went beyond business management.

events.title: 사장 자리를 내주고 회장으로 물러나다
events.title_en: He stepped down as president to become chairman
events.description: 마쓰시타 전기산업 사장 자리에서 물러나 회장이 되며 일선 경영에서 한 걸음 물러났다.
events.description_en: He stepped down as president of Matsushita Electric Industrial and became chairman, moving a step back from day-to-day management.

events.title: 상담역으로 물러나 경영에서 완전히 손을 떼다
events.title_en: He retired to an advisory post and left management entirely
events.description: 회장 자리도 내려놓고 상담역으로 물러나며 회사 경영에서 완전히 손을 뗐다.
events.description_en: He stepped down as chairman as well, taking an advisory role and leaving company management entirely.

events.title: 사재를 털어 마쓰시타 정경숙을 세우다
events.title_en: He spent his own fortune to found the Matsushita Institute of Government and Management
events.description: 자신의 재산을 들여 정치·경영 지도자를 기르는 4년제 교육기관 마쓰시타 정경숙을 세웠다. 여러 일본 정치인과 기업인이 이곳을 거쳐 나갔다.
events.description_en: He spent his own fortune to found the Matsushita Institute of Government and Management, a four-year school for training political and business leaders. Many Japanese politicians and executives later passed through it.

events.title: 세상을 떠나다
events.description_en: He died at the age of ninety-four.
